title: Twin knocked out when brother is sedated

tellings.quote: So he gave me a shot of something to knock me out and a minute later, Jack goes out cold.

plain: Sometime between 1957 and 1959, near Allentown, Pennsylvania, the family doctor gave a boy named Jim Weiner a shot to knock him out, and a minute later his twin brother Jack, who had been given nothing, "goes out cold." Jim Weiner, who was the twin given the shot, tells Michels this himself and says the doctor wrote it up in a report and a local newspaper ran a story on it. If true, it would point to a link between the two brothers' bodies that medicine cannot explain.
